payload.core_mechanism_summary: Memoized DP over intervals with an extra dimension 'extra' tracking how many characters, identical to the rightmost run, are appended for merging after removals.
payload.rationale: The DP state (start, end, extra) uses two primary interval indices and an additional parameter, fitting a multi-dimensional state. It is the highest-scoring subtype and captures the interval merging DP pattern typical for string removal problems.
